text_blocks.snippet: Cardiac issues can arise after a COVID-19 infection, even in individuals without prior heart conditions. These issues can manifest as chest pain, palpitations, rapid heart rate, dizziness, and shortness of breath with exertion. Some research indicates that COVID-19 can lead to long-term changes in the heart and lungs, potentially resulting in cardiac and pulmonary diseases.
